# RFDB recording fixtures

Typhoon is an owner-created recording downloaded from RFDB, covered by the
[central owner grant](../../../ASSET_LICENSES.md). The
[recording catalog](../../../docs/development/RECORDINGS.md#typhoon) identifies its
inclusion authorization, original filename, byte length and SHA-256.
Preserve the original bytes, including all metadata and unknown fields.

The complete [CC BY-SA 4.0 legal text](../real/LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt) is retained
with the recording fixtures for redistribution.
